lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a crowdsourced geographic database maintained by volunteers. The dataset represents approximately 12% of estimated total buildings in Chile based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 4 years and 8% of features updated within the last 6 months. Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for exposure assessment applications.
